items.information: If the number of participants are more than 70 in any event, we may restrict the further participants. Partipants needs to pre-register in WCA as they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 8th January 2017 to participate. Participation registration closes on 6th January 2017 at 9:00pm IST. Payment should be made before 6th January 2017 10:00pm IST. Participation will be cancelled if there is a failure of WCA registration or the payment is not made before the given cut off time. All the participants are recommended to be available 30 minutes before the event of participation in the venue. Non-Indian nationality participants are requested to bring their passport.
